issue.title: Snoozed Tasks: plan it for today, wake it at a time
issue.description: Bryan can snooze any open, non-Event task to a clock time today from its Task Link, its definition, capture, or the CLI. While asleep the task is clearly marked with a clock and its time, stays out of Today, the walks, and plan.max_links. At its time, bob wakes it into an untimed open Pomodoro, the woken Task Link shows its wake time, and one hard-to-miss notice announces it and then goes away on its own.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: Shared relative-time wording/rounding needs an outer-epic resolution before final docs/vector rollout. Proposed by bob-cli-q5.3.1.2 note #2; this lander reviewed snooze/when.rs and docs/snooze.md. parse_relative_delta rounds the duration (ceil(delta/5)*5), then resolve_relative adds it to unrounded now: 12:03 +45m -> 12:48, +1h -> 13:03. docs/snooze.md says relative times round upward to a five-minute boundary. q5.1 note #2 already flags the same interpretation (13:02 +45m -> 13:47). Capture correctly shares the core parser and pins that result; do not introduce capture-only time semantics. payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: (found by the bob-cli-q5.4.1 land agent) bob snooze wake's deferred report omits fields docs/snooze.md promises for every wake report. src/native/snooze/cli.rs deferred_action() (from bob-cli-q5.1.1.3, commit 68dee6e1) emits only schema_version/date/now/status=deferred/daily_file/notified/wake_id, while docs/snooze.md says Wake reports status, woken, dropped, ignored, pending, next_wake_at, plan, daily_file, notified, and wake_id. Strict consumers that follow the doc reject it: the bob-ledger-tools waker decoder returns bad-shape for the real deferred envelope (reproduced with node against helpers.snoozeWakeDecodeReport on 2026-11-26). Impact: low (deferral retries next minute), but the Mac exact-minute waker (bob-cli-q5.7) and any other decoder face the same mismatch. Fix: either emit empty woken/dropped/ignored/pending, null next_wake_at and the plan block on deferred, or document the slim deferred envelope. The plugin side is being made tolerant of the current slim shape in the bob-cli-q5.4.1 landing tale.
